inputs.instruction: Investigate project/ for the Family Task Manager. Report: (1) every file/directory under project/ that is NOT one of the five canonical docs (family-task-manager-spec.md, ROADMAP.md, IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md, DECISIONS.md, README.md); (2) whether project/package.json exists; (3) whether project/src/ exists. If nothing exists beyond the docs, report that clearly.

Create two new files for Phase 1 of the Family Task Manager. JavaScript ESM, zero runtime dependencies. Use before: null (new file creation).

File 1 — project/package.json:
{"type":"module","scripts":{"test":"node --test tests/phase1.test.js"}}

File 2 — project/src/context.js:
Export a named constant FTM_CONTEXT object (no default export) with exactly:
  ftm: 'https://schema.familytaskmanager.local/v1/'
  xsd: 'http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#'
  schema: 'https://schema.org/'
No side effects. No I/O. No other exports needed.

Acceptance criteria (IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN 1.1): FTM_CONTEXT.ftm/xsd/schema match exactly; module has zero side effects on import.

Read project/src/context.js and project/package.json. Report their exact exports and structure. Also read SPEC §3.2 and §3.3 (lines 59-141 of project/family-task-manager-spec.md) covering TaskDefinition and TaskInstance schemas. Report file paths, line ranges, and all field names.

Read project/src/entities/taskDefinition.js and project/src/entities/taskInstance.js. Report their exact export signatures and field structure. Also read SPEC §3.4 and §3.5 (ReminderEvent and User schemas) from project/family-task-manager-spec.md. Report file paths and line ranges.

Create two new entity files matching the pattern established in taskDefinition.js and taskInstance.js. JavaScript ESM. No dependencies. before: null for both.

File 1 — project/src/entities/reminderEvent.js:
Export createReminderEvent(sentAt, deliveryStatus) per SPEC §3.4.
Throw an Error if deliveryStatus is not one of: 'delivered', 'failed', 'deferred'.
Return: { '@type':'ftm:ReminderEvent', 'ftm:sentAt':{'@type':'xsd:dateTime','@value':sentAt}, 'ftm:deliveryStatus':deliveryStatus }

File 2 — project/src/entities/user.js:
Export createUser(params) per SPEC §3.5.
params shape: { role, displayName, notificationTokens=[] }
Throw if role not in ['parent','child'].
Throw if displayName is empty string or not a string.
Return:
  @context: 'https://schema.familytaskmanager.local/v1/'
  @type: 'ftm:User'
  @id: 'urn:ftm:user:' + crypto.randomUUID()
  ftm:role: params.role
  ftm:displayName: params.displayName
  ftm:notificationTokens: params.notificationTokens ?? []
No I/O. No side effects.

Read ALL files under project/src/ (context.js, entities/taskDefinition.js, entities/taskInstance.js, entities/reminderEvent.js, entities/user.js). Report exact export signatures and field names for each. Also read SPEC §11 (validation rules, lines 585-631 of project/family-task-manager-spec.md). Report file paths and line ranges.

Create two new validation modules. JavaScript ESM. No dependencies. before: null for both.

File 1 — project/src/validation/validateTaskDefinition.js:
Export validateTaskDefinition(td) returning { valid: boolean, errors: string[] }.
Validate ALL §11 TaskDefinition rules (read SPEC §11 from UPSTREAM reconnaissance):
- ftm:title must be a non-empty string with length <= 200; error: 'title must be non-empty string <= 200 chars'
- If ftm:schedule['ftm:scheduleType'] === 'recurring': ftm:schedule['ftm:recurrenceRule'] must be non-null and non-empty; error: 'recurring task requires recurrenceRule'
- If ftm:schedule['ftm:scheduleType'] === 'recurring': ftm:schedule['ftm:recurrenceStart'] must be non-null and non-empty; error: 'recurring task requires recurrenceStart'
- If ftm:schedule['ftm:recurrenceStart'] is non-null: must be parseable as a date (new Date(v).toString() !== 'Invalid Date'); error: 'recurrenceStart must be valid ISO-8601 datetime'
- If ftm:reminderPolicy['ftm:mode'] === 'persistent': ftm:reminderPolicy['ftm:intervalSeconds'] must be an integer >= 60; error: 'persistent mode requires intervalSeconds >= 60'
- If ftm:reminderPolicy['ftm:persistUntilSeconds'] is non-null AND ftm:reminderPolicy['ftm:intervalSeconds'] is non-null: persistUntilSeconds must be >= intervalSeconds; error: 'persistUntilSeconds must be >= intervalSeconds'
// TODO: assignedTo role check (SPEC §11) deferred to Phase 4 — requires StateAdapter.getUser() not available until Phase 3. Operator decision I10.

File 2 — project/src/validation/validateTaskInstance.js:
Export validateTaskInstance(ti) returning { valid: boolean, errors: string[] }.
Validate ALL §11 TaskInstance rules:
- ftm:dueAt['@value'] must be a valid ISO-8601 datetime (parseable, not 'Invalid Date'); error: 'dueAt must be a valid ISO-8601 datetime'
- ftm:clientSequence must be a positive integer (> 0, Number.isInteger, no decimals); error: 'clientSequence must be a positive integer'

Read all Phase 1 source files: project/src/context.js, project/src/entities/taskDefinition.js, project/src/entities/taskInstance.js, project/src/entities/reminderEvent.js, project/src/entities/user.js, project/src/validation/validateTaskDefinition.js, project/src/validation/validateTaskInstance.js. For each file report the exact export names and function signatures. Also read project/package.json. Report all file paths and line ranges.

Create two new files. JavaScript ESM. No dependencies. before: null for both.

File 1 — project/src/utils/roundTrip.js:
Export two functions per SPEC §2 and §3 (IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN 1.6):
- stripFtmPrefix(entity): returns a NEW shallow-copy object where every key starting with 'ftm:' has the prefix removed (e.g. 'ftm:title' -> 'title'). Keys starting with '@' ('@context','@type','@id') are preserved unchanged. Does NOT mutate the input.
- expandFtmPrefix(stripped): returns a NEW shallow-copy where every non-'@' key has 'ftm:' prepended (e.g. 'title' -> 'ftm:title'). '@' keys preserved unchanged. Does NOT mutate the input.

File 2 — project/tests/phase1.test.js:
Test suite using Node.js built-in node:test. Import as: import { test, describe } from 'node:test'; import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
All imports use relative paths from tests/ (e.g. '../src/context.js').

Write describe blocks covering ALL acceptance criteria from IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN tasks 1.1-1.8:

describe('1.1 context', ...) — assert FTM_CONTEXT.ftm/xsd/schema exact values

describe('1.2 TaskDefinition factory', ...) covering:
- @type === 'ftm:TaskDefinition'
- @id matches /^urn:ftm:task:/
- ftm:version === 1, ftm:clientSequence === 1, ftm:status === 'active'
- one-time: ftm:schedule['ftm:scheduleType'] === 'one-time', recurrenceRule null, recurrenceStart null
- recurring: ftm:schedule['ftm:scheduleType'] === 'recurring', recurrenceRule/Start non-null
- once mode: ftm:reminderPolicy['ftm:mode'] === 'once', intervalSeconds null
- no I/O (call factory twice, confirm two distinct @id values)

describe('1.3 TaskInstance factory', ...) covering:
- @type === 'ftm:TaskInstance', @id matches /^urn:ftm:instance:/
- ftm:completionState['ftm:status'] === 'pending', completedAt/By/ByRole null
- ftm:reminderSummary['ftm:totalSent'] === 0, recentEvents empty array
- ftm:clientSequence === 1

describe('1.4 ReminderEvent', ...) covering:
- valid status 'delivered' accepted (no throw)
- valid status 'failed' accepted
- valid status 'deferred' accepted
- invalid status 'unknown' throws

describe('1.5 User factory', ...) covering:
- @type === 'ftm:User'
- ftm:role 'parent' accepted, 'child' accepted
- ftm:displayName non-empty string stored
- ftm:notificationTokens default is empty array

describe('1.6 round-trip', ...) covering:
- JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(td)) deep-equals original TaskDefinition
- stripFtmPrefix then expandFtmPrefix round-trips to original (use assert.deepEqual)
- '@context', '@type', '@id' survive both directions unchanged

describe('1.7 validateTaskDefinition', ...) covering all AC from IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN 1.7:
- empty title => errors.length > 0
- title of 201 chars => errors.length > 0
- title of 200 chars => no title error
- recurring + recurrenceRule null => errors includes recurring rule error
- recurring + recurrenceStart null => errors includes recurrenceStart error
- recurring + recurrenceStart 'not-a-date' => errors includes datetime error
- persistent + intervalSeconds 59 => errors.length > 0
- persistent + intervalSeconds 60 => no intervalSeconds error
- persistUntilSeconds 100, intervalSeconds 200 => errors.length > 0
- persistUntilSeconds 200, intervalSeconds 200 => no persistUntilSeconds error
- fully valid one-time TaskDefinition => valid === true, errors.length === 0

describe('1.8 validateTaskInstance', ...) covering:
- dueAt '@value' 'not-a-datetime' => errors.length > 0
- clientSequence 0 => errors.length > 0
- clientSequence -1 => errors.length > 0
- clientSequence 1.5 => errors.length > 0
- valid dueAt '2026-05-22T18:00:00Z' + clientSequence 1 => valid === true, no errors

Use createTaskDefinition/createTaskInstance factories to build test fixtures where needed. Keep each test small and self-contained.
